protocol.status: historical: reported from the original campaign; not reproduced by this repository's CI
protocol.evaluation: 20 random 70/30 train/test partitions (random_state 0-19); a fresh model is trained on each
protocol.optimiser: Adam, lr 1e-4, batch 32, cross-entropy, all parameters fine-tuned
protocol.artifacts_kept: aggregate numbers and the three figures only; no per-split logs, split indices or weights
protocol.note: This repository stratifies splits by default. --no-stratify restores the protocol above; split indices will match only if the class folders and file order match the original dataset copy.

epoch_study.description: Hybrid model trained for 60 epochs with test evaluations every 10 epochs, averaged over the 20 splits
epoch_study.finding: Training loss fell from 3.15 to 0.30 within two epochs and was near zero after six; mean accuracy at epoch 60 (98.44%) was no better than at epoch 10, so the final protocol stops at 10 epochs.
